name: ◆ 💎 DIAMONDSMP ◆
description:
Welcome To DiamondSMP!

We’re thrilled to finally share the news…

Our brand new Minecraft server is launching soon! 

We're starting off strong with our Vanilla-style DiamondSMP Map, enhanced with custom enchantments and a few other bits to help you long the way to bring a fresh twist to classic survival gameplay. 

But that’s just the beginning 

Here’s what you can look forward to as we expand:

 OPPrisons – Grind, rank up, and rule the mines

 Lifesteal (with a twist) – PvP with high stakes and a unique spin

 BoxSMP – A new take on compact survival

 Skyblock – Start from nothing and build to the skies

 Top Secret Gamemodes – Surprises you won't want to miss...

We’re building something special, and we can’t wait for you to be a part of it.

Stay tuned for sneak peeks, launch dates, and early access info 

Let the hype begin!
